_comment: Canonical current catalog for every governed dataset, model and reference asset. It is the only live source for identity, lifecycle, acquisition status, access limits, revisions and local verification. The original June/July frozen baseline remains embedded as the frozen-baseline profile; non-baseline and planned assets are in asset_catalog. Large bytes live under SPEECHRL_DATA_DIR and are never committed.
generated: 2026-08-02; baseline history retained below; non-baseline catalog refreshed from the 2026-07-23 full inventory and the 2026-08-02 R2 acquisition audit

profiles.frozen-baseline: The reproducible June/July baseline; default fetch profile for backward compatibility.
profiles.local-candidates: Observed non-baseline local assets; presence does not authorize an experiment.
profiles.r2-core: Earnings21, Earnings22 and ConEC Stage-2A minimum data closure.
profiles.r2-diagnostics: PRISM, Rare5k and BuzzWord diagnostic carriers.
profiles.r2-secondary: SLUE-SQA-5 and ContextASR-Bench public secondary carriers.
profiles.r2-annotations: TED-EL annotations only; TED-LIUM3 audio remains source-unstable.
profiles.r2-small-public: Small optional public assets: ATCO2-1h, Eka-Medical and LibriSQA.
profiles.deferred: Cataloged but intentionally not in the current acquisition wave.

status_model.COMPLETE: Required bytes for this record are present at the recorded identity.
status_model.PARTIAL: Some bytes or metadata are present but the record is not complete.
status_model.MISSING: No governed local copy is present.
status_model.BLOCKED: Acquisition is prevented by access, source stability, publication or privacy constraints.

acquisition_policy.rule: Datasets larger than 1 TB are excluded from acquisition and from the active research reference set; retain only a tombstone catalog record so they cannot silently re-enter scope.

changes.note: aime24/aime25/aime26 and seed-tts-eval were misfiled as "task": "asr" (a copy/paste leftover from the modelscope-manual fetch template; their factor_family was always correct). Corrected in place: aime24/aime25/aime26 -> "task": "text-reasoning-eval"; seed-tts-eval -> "task": "tts-eval". No revision/size/source field was touched.

Enumerating (not changing) the 10/28 dataset entries whose "revision" is unpinned/content-fingerprint-only rather than a real pinned commit/tag -- i.e. "revision" contains "unpinned -- content-fingerprinted" (modelscope master, no tag) or "unknown (no local metadata -- content-fingerprinted)" (source gave no version metadata at all). These are frozen the same way as every other entry (size_bytes + files fingerprint), just without an upstream revision string to re-pin against.
